bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gsol mchod nyung ngur bsdus pa 'dod 'jo'i snye ma zhes bya ba/rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /gang gi yon ta

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gsol mchod nyung ngur bsdus pa 'dod 'jo'i snye ma zhes bya ba/1$0000300 rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// gang gi yon tan dran pas gus btud nas// bod yul skyong ba brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi// gsol mchod nyung ngu'i phrin las dbyangs su len//

gtsang ma'i stegs bur mchod gtor dam rdzas bkod// gser skyems dkar phud spos sna'i bsang dud sbyar// mda' dar ru mtshon lhab lhub spyan gzigs dang*// snyan pa'i rol mo dbyangs bcas 'di skad gyer// ka dag chos sku'i dbyings las 'gag med rtsal// pad+ma thod phreng dkar dmar gzhon tshul can// mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar rdo rje thod pa 'dzin// mdzes brjid rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs// dam ye gnyis med rgyal kun 'dus pa'i gzugs// 'khor 'das kun gyi spyi dpal chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas la spyan 'dren pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis brtan ma rnams// sngon gyi dam tshig rjes bskul sprin phung bzhin// mdun gyi nam mkhar thogs med gshegs par bsam/ kye/ tshogs dang bka' yi tshogs bcas nyid/ khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku /tshur gshegs tshur byon skyong ma rnams// 'dir byon dam skongs phrin las mdzod// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ me tog tshal dang spos sprin gtibs// mar me gzi 'bar dri chab klung*// ro ldan zhal zas snyan brjid sgra /'chi med bdud rtsi dmar chen khrag /ba liṃ 'dod yon gtor ma sogs// phyi nang mchod sprin dam tshig rdzas// thugs la dgyes dgur gang 'char ba// dngos bshams yid las rnam sprul pas// rab 'byams nam mkha' yongs bkang ste// ma gcig kong btsun de mo sogs// dam can brtan ma bcu gnyis po// 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la// 'bul lo dgyes shing tshims par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas/ shab+da a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta ma hā pū dza hoḥ zhes pas mchod nas bstod cing phrin bcol ni/ o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// bka' nyan bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma rnams// mdzes brjid sku la sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// mi zad cho 'phrul 'dod dgur sgyur ba yi// phrin las thogs med dam tshig rjes gcod ma// bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bstod// bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma// dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong*// gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang*// 'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso// bdud mo bzhi yang 'dir gshegs gtor ma bzhes// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// sha med gangs dkar rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/

kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum// gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang*// rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal// gnod sbyin gzhi yang 'dir gshegs gtor ma bzhes// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong*// btsan la drag mo rdo rje sman gcig ma// g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje zu le ma// sman btsun khug chos rdo rje g.yar mo sil// sman btsun bzhi yang 'dir gshegs gtor ma bzhes// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// brtan ma bcu gnyis sman phran 'bum dang bcas// bran g.yog 'khor bcas gtor ma 'di longs la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// bar chad dgra bgegs nad dang gnod pa'i tshogs// mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi dang zlog pa dang*// rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ khyad par pad+ma thod phreng bka' bsgos ltar// so kha srungs la kla klo'i 'tshe ba zlog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*// bod khams mtha' dbus rtag tu bde bar mdzod// ces pas dam bskul phrin las gnyer dam bya// mchod bstod nongs bshags rang bzhin gnas su gshegs// dge ba bsngo zhing shis brjod mtha' brgyan no// de ltar bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi// phrin las tshig nyung dgos pa'i don tshang ba// gang 'di sngags 'chang tshe bdag dpa' bo yis// bskul ngor rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje'i sdes// sbyar ba'i yig mkhan blo gsal rgya mtsho 'o/// /
